review.summary: PREP-1 to PREP-4 are verified for the preparation scope only. The spike separates measured results (the in-process decision probe, exit 0, stable source hash) from historical summaries and unexecuted Q1/Q2 hypotheses. It never claims research completion, independent review or publication.
unrelated: spike.md still says Claude launch currently fails and the privacy scanner is absent. The batch notes this is historical status, but a dated update line in the spike would remove the apparent contradiction.
Q1/Q2 remain source-only concerns until an approved experiment adapter and a real isolation probe exist. The Q3 probe covers only the exported decide and evaluateCriteria functions.

assessments.reason: spike.md Grounding names the scripts/specflow-improve.cjs functions, the I-IMPROVE-001/002/003/005/006/011 invariants (all present in feature_improve_core.yml), the improve-core test file and PRD sections 1 and 6. It labels HeyStax material as historical summaries and Q1/Q2 as source-level concerns. decision-probe.json records the measured Q3 observation with a pinned source_sha256.

The Q1-Q3 matrix gives controls, expected behavior, evidence to retain and the rule that unavailable is not a pass. It also sets a 90-minute timebox and retry stop, and REQ-01 to REQ-05. The Q3 probe shows KEEP for preservation-only input, with REVERT controls for mandatory regression and empty diff, desired_behavior_met false and stated limitations. The Duo capture shows exitCode 0, stable true and sourceBefore equal to sourceAfter.

spike.md 'Initial recommendation to challenge' recommends evidence binding (Q1/Q2) first and gain semantics (Q3) as a separate slice, with four ranked deferred follow-ups. It leaves receipt reuse versus a new receipt, legacy INCONCLUSIVE versus a new run, and gain thresholds as open research questions. AC-3 and the simulation's open questions keep these decisions explicit.

simulation.md has four personas with happy and divergent routes, and proposals labelled as not applied. audit.md has the three phases (gap analysis, surgical uplift, pre-flight) and says it is the builder's audit, not independent acceptance. It states that research execution is incomplete and publication is pending. Nothing is reported as passed that did not run.

diagnostics.observation: The Duo capture of the decision probe ran node evidence/improve-trust-spike/decision-probe.cjs on 2026-10-09, exiting 0 with empty stderr and identical sourceBefore and sourceAfter hashes. stdout shows decision KEEP for preservation-only evidence, REVERT for both controls, and desired_behavior_met false.

direction.goal_connection: The preparation packet advances the trust-layer mission by targeting unsupported KEEP decisions. Its function-level observation is honestly bounded, and no research completion or production claim is made.
